name: tensioner-frame
title: Tensioner: the frame
description: The base the three shafts stand in (4 mm steel rods, pressed in) and the post the pawl stands on, outside every gear's reach.

length.rule: From behind the crank to past the pawl's post

start.rule: Behind the crank's pinion (14.25 mm tips)

wide.rule: Under the spool shaft's gear (39.75 mm tips) both sides

thick.rule: Eight millimetres: deep enough to hold a rod upright

rod.rule: A 4 mm rod pressed in: a quarter line under

mid_x.rule: The middle shaft: m (17 + 34) / 2 from the crank

post_x.rule: The pawl's post: under its root, just outside the spool gear's tips (40.6 mm from its shaft)

post.rule: Square: the pawl's 50 N at its top bends it to 3 MPa

post_height.rule: Up to the ratchet's level, two layers' gap and all
